item.title: Giant Attack is a rematch against SiRN Akuma but with a reward that seemingly references the Midnight Bliss technique from Darkstalkers

item.title: Mortal Kombat: Legacy Kollection goes on sale for the first time
item.description: <p>Many of the <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2025/nov/27/black-friday-fighting-game-sales/">big Black Friday sales</a> are coming to an end if they haven't already, but there's still more deals fighting game players can take advantage of.</p> <p>Digital Eclipse is now running their first sale on the Mortal Kombat: Legacy Kollection since the game launched just over a month ago.</p>

item.title: PlayStation's End of Year Deals offer big sales on fighting games with Mortal Kombat 1: Definitive Edition going to 75% off and more
item.description: <p>Most <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2025/nov/27/black-friday-fighting-game-sales/">Black Friday deals</a> may be done and over with now, but there's still plenty of ways to save money on fighting games right now.</p> <p>PlayStation just launched its End of Year Deals event, which features a bunch of big fighting game discounts that are worth checking out.</p>

item.title: It's your last chance to sign up for Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls' second beta test
item.description: <p>There's a couple of big fighting game tests going down this weekend, and you still have a little bit of time to sign up for at least one of them.</p> <p>PlayStation and Arc System Works are set to conduct the <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2025/nov/11/marvel-tokon-second-beta/">second closed beta test for Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls</a>, but time is running out to try and get in on the action.</p>

item.title: New Build Your Own Capcom Ultimate Bundle from Fanatical includes the Capcom Fighting Collection 2 and more at unbeatable prices
item.description: <p>While most <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2025/nov/27/black-friday-fighting-game-sales/">Black Friday deals</a> may be over with now, we're still finding more ways to save on big fighting games this holiday season.</p> <p>Fanatical is now running a new Build Your Own Capcom Ultimate Bundle, which can let you pick up a number of Capcom's largest titles at a nice discount as the name suggests.</p>
